title: Who Said It: To be the man

segments.voice: One line. One legend. Can you name him before the reveal?
To be the man, you've got to beat the man.
segments.screen: To be the man, you've got to beat the man.

segments.voice: It's the Nature Boy, Ric Flair. Wooo!
Flair said it for decades on his way to 16 world championships, and every champion since has had to live by it.
Be honest. Did you get it before the reveal?

caption:
WHO SAID IT? Most fans get this one in 2 seconds.
One of the most famous lines in wrestling history. Did you guess it before the reveal? Tell us in the comments.
